map.⚖️ 计费重量取大者: ⚖️ Chargeable Weight Is the Larger One
map.体积重 = 长 × 宽 × 高 ÷ 抛比。计费重量取「实际重量」与「体积重」的较: Volumetric weight = length × width × height ÷ divisor. Chargeable weight is the greater of actual weight and volumetric weight. Bulky light cargo is usually billed by volume: a 60×50×40 cm box has a volumetric weight of 20 kg and is charged as 20 kg even if it only weighs 15 kg.

Loss or damage without cover is typically compensated as a multiple of freight or capped, so declare full value on costly goods and keep packing video plus the waybill.
